highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 brings Skia m158 with corrections to filtered images, glyph rendering and GPU failure handling.
highlights_body: The SkiaSharp managed API remains unchanged. Co-shipping HarfBuzzSharp upgrades to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds named script constants while preserving its existing Script programming model.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 and incorporates subsequent m158 fixes without changing the SkiaSharp managed binding surface.

bullets.lead: Filtered images stay within their intended pixels
bullets.detail: Antialiased, minified and skewed draws retain texture-subset clamping where needed, and filtered scratch images avoid sampling unwritten mipmap texels. Displacement offsets now use the same precision as filter bounds, and image-filter cache equality agrees with hashing.

bullets.lead: Glyph formats and LCD cropping respected
bullets.detail: Mask-filtered glyphs use regenerated outlines and compatible mask formats, clear clipped output and preserve full 3D plane strides. FreeType LCD16 glyph bounds are converted to pixel coordinates before consistent cropping, with checks on bitmap dimensions and buffer bounds.

bullets.lead: Hairline caps and text-atlas selection corrected
bullets.detail: Reflected transforms no longer incorrectly enlarge zero-length square-capped hairlines. Text-atlas sampler selection tolerates interpolation imprecision for ordinary and LCD glyph lookups.

bullets.lead: GPU failures and oversized allocations handled safely
bullets.detail: Ganesh propagates native flush and synchronous Vulkan wait failures; GRContext.Submit remains void. Invalid buffer sizes and oversized Imagination MSAA attachments are rejected. Affected ARM Vulkan device-loss paths delay teardown, and Imagination out-of-memory paths avoid unsafe descriptor-pool destruction.

bullets.lead: GPU draw bounds and ordering preserved
bullets.detail: Destination reads are constrained to their intended bounds. Graphite rejects draws whose clips cannot fit a fresh render pass and resets depth after full-overwrite draws to preserve painter order.

The shared HashCode polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now uses cryptographic randomness for its seed. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process; first use now initializes the cryptography library.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Updated the shared hash-code seed to OS-generated randomness and added analyzer safeguards for shipped code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14: Release Candidate 1 corrected antialiased texture-subset clamping and image-filter cache key equality. Mask-filtered glyph rendering now respects regenerated paths, compatible formats and clipped plane layouts.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17: Preview 3 aligned displacement offsets with filter-bounds precision and corrected native synchronous Vulkan wait failure reporting without changing GRContext.Submit. The shared hash-code polyfill switched to OS-generated randomness.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 upgraded HarfBuzzSharp to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and added 30 named Script constants. GPU fixes covered reflected hairline caps, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip limits and device-loss teardown on affected ARM Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduced Skia m158 without changing the managed binding surface. HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.300 while its native engine remained at 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Upgrades bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing constants, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup are preserved; Font(Face) continues to construct fonts through hb_font_create.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: Preview 1 brings Skia m158 with unchanged managed bindings.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: HarfBuzzSharp uses package revision 14.4.0.300; its bundled native HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.

v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.headline: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling.
v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.body: The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated randomness while remaining stable within a process. Managed API signatures are unchanged.

v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects filtered image subsets and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14.body: It prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from entering antialiased filtered draws and makes image-filter cache equality consistent with hashing. Regenerated glyph outlines, mask formats and clipped planes are handled correctly without changing managed APIs.

v4.158.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 completes the m158 release with native rendering and GPU reliability fixes.
v4.158.0.body: The stable shipment corrects FreeType LCD glyph cropping and filtered scratch-image sampling, constrains destination reads and preserves Graphite painter order after overwrite draws. Ganesh handles flush failures and invalid allocation sizes, with targeted Imagination GPU allocation and cleanup protections. Managed APIs and dependency versions are unchanged from Release Candidate 1.
